description: As a firm supporter of the Second Amendment, I believe in the right to bear arms—but that right comes with a critical responsibility. Recent tragedies, like the one in Lehi where a child found a loaded gun and accidentally shot himself, remind us that negligence can have fatal consequences. We must secure our firearms and educate our children about gun safety. Protect your family by being a responsible gun owner. Secure it, teach it, live it.

title: Responsible Gun Ownership: The Non-Negotiable Duty to Protect Our Children | The 52 Report
